criteria.silhouette_scale: Stout trapezoidal ingot, lighter top, graphite side and narrow silver edges survive export; broad scuffs retain steel character.
criteria.implementable_geometry: Single static generated-item sprite, transparent padded silhouette.
criteria.mechanics_clearance: Ingot is solid cast metal; rod shaft and center socket visibly meet its wooden crossbar. No moving mechanism.
criteria.period_materials: Cool steel and plain wood/iron suit practical period manufacture without decorative brass.
criteria.family_consistency: References inspected: engine metal palette and Machine Parts pixel clusters; functional material treatment retained.
criteria.controls_readability: No UI; cast bar and probing tool have distinct silhouettes.
criteria.gameplay_scope: Appearance only, preserving recipes and all prospecting behavior.

criteria.matches_direction: Stout trapezoidal ingot, lighter top, graphite side and narrow silver edges survive export; broad scuffs retain steel character.
criteria.geometry_uvs: 32x32 native sprite, binary alpha, at most 16 opaque colors and transparent padding; native generated-item JSON.
criteria.material_consistency: Blue-gray steel planes have restrained wear; rod wood remains warm and distinct from cool metal.
criteria.assembly_interfaces: Existing item IDs retained; no block interface or placement change.
criteria.native_size_readability: Inspected dark/light native views and grid: ingot edges clear; slender rod shaft remains connected and T-grip recognizable.

criteria.photon_materials: Photon world lighting darkens steel naturally; inventory highlights remain clear without alpha artifacts.
criteria.scale_readability: Steel has comparable ingot footprint to vanilla iron/copper with a distinct cooler darker hue. Rod shaft remains visible in slots and frames.
criteria.states_motion: Static sprites; held rod inspected with the native transform, grip and shaft remain coherent.
criteria.interaction_guides: Existing prospecting interaction unchanged; no placement guide.
criteria.inventory_appearance: Compared beside Machine Parts, iron and copper: cool metal family consistent, warm wooden grip distinct, similar edge contrast and restrained wear. Rod intentionally has less filled area than solid ingots.
criteria.integration_limits: Build/unit and focused manufactured Photon scene passed. Inventory, frames visible in held view and held rod reviewed. No recipe or prospecting behavior changes.
